report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate the operator's deployment-regression hypothesis. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200 with no errors. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows zero traffic. The only deployment record is baseline v1.0.0 with no previous version, so no faulty deployment is evidenced. No bounded cause is established; hand off.
missing_evidence: Error-bearing traces or logs showing checkout failures (order-logs was excluded from context)
Metrics or logs demonstrating a failing deployment version or rollout event
Evidence of the specific failure mode (5xx, pool exhaustion, redis timeout, latency) to bound a cause
